property_summary: The reference contract requires msg.sender to be the original hardcoded address 0x9797... for transfer to proceed, so any call from a different sender reverts; the buggy mutant requires msg.sender == 0x000...0001, so calls from the original sender revert and calls from the mutant-allowed sender succeed, causing a revert-status difference when called by the original sender.
change_summary: Replace the require(msg.sender == ...) condition with a different address so that calls from the original sender revert but another address can proceed.
